name: Schedule View
description: Windows MDM settings in the Schedule View category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Do not allow horizontal calendar view (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting allows you to prevent horizontal calendar view.

If you enable this policy setting, horizontal calendar view is not allowed.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, horizontal calendar view is allowed.

properties.name: Prevent My Department Calendar from appearing (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting prevents My Department Calendar from appearing in the navigation pane.

If you enable this policy setting, My Department Calendar will not appear in the navigation pane.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, My Department Calendar will appear in the navigation pane.

properties.name: Prevent Other Department Calendar from appearing (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting prevents Other Department Calendar from appearing in the navigation pane.

If you enable this policy setting, Other Department Calendar will not appear in the navigation pane.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, Other Department Calendar will appear in the navigation pane.

properties.name: Prevent Reporting Line Group Calendar from appearing (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting prevents Reporting Line Group Calendar from appearing in the navigation pane.

If you enable this policy setting, Reporting Line Group Calendar will not appear in the navigation pane.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, My Reporting Line Group Calendar will appear in the navigation pane.

properties.name: Turn off auto-switching from horizontal to vertical layout (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting controls auto switching of calendar layouts from horizontal to vertical. 

If you enable this policy setting, auto-switching is turned off.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, auto-switching is turned on.

properties.name: Turn off auto-switching from vertical to horizontal layout (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting controls auto-switching of calendar layouts from vertical to horizontal.

If you enable this policy setting, auto-switching is turned off.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, auto-switching is turned on.

properties.name: Turn off Legacy Group Calendar migration (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting controls the migration of legacy Group Calendar. 

If you enable this policy setting, migration will be turned off.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, migration will be turned on.

properties.name: Turn off sharing recommendation (User)
properties.description:
This policy setting controls the sharing recommendation feature. 

If you enable this policy setting, the recommendation will be turned off.

If you disable or do not configure this policy setting, the recommendation will be turned on.
